title: Warranty Registration Workflow Monthly Throughput Trend
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=warranty:registration
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as items sum(eval(if(registration_status="registered",1,0))) as completed by _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how many warranty registrations entered the system each month and how many actually got completed.
value: Throughput trend lines show whether the queue is shrinking, flat, or quietly becoming a backlog.
implementation: Use this after any process cleanup to see whether the change actually improved completion volume.
visualization: Column chart of monthly created versus completed warranty registrations.
grandmaExplanation: It checks whether you are clearing warranty registrations as fast as they arrive each month.
